aboutBlock.title: About the lawyer
aboutBlock.text: A graduate of the Master's program at the Academy of the Ministry of Internal Affairs, he later worked as an investigator within the MIA's investigative bodies. This experience gives him first-hand insight into how the prosecution builds its case. Today he practices as a defense attorney handling criminal, administrative, and civil matters at the MAXLEGAL AND JUSTICE law firm.
